newsitem.title: UK: Serco JV preferred bidder in ports contract.
newsitem.headline: Serco JV preferred bidder in ports contract.

text.p: Defence Maritime Services, jointly owned by Serco Asia Pacific Pty Ltd and P&O Maritime Services Pty Ltd, has been named preferred tenderer for the provision of port services and support craft for the Royal Australian Navy contract, said Serco Group Plc.
The contract is for a ten year period starting in January 1998 with a projected turnover over the 10 years of about A$300 million.

The contract will involve the provision of harbour services to the Royal Australian Navy in all major base areas, including Sydney, Jarvis Bay, Darwin and Perth, support for the fleet operational training and submarine and surface sea trials.
It will also include the provision of support craft and related services for the Royal Association Navy, said Serco in a statement.
